result.citation: S.F. Admin. Code ch. 49 (section not stated)
result.citation_basis: ch. 49: O040 (Admin. Code § 37.6 refers to "Administrative Code Chapter 49 ("Interest Rates on Security Deposits)"); 4.2% rate and periods: D083
result.note: Added "(section not stated)" because O040's § 37.6 confirms the security deposit interest rule sits in S.F. Admin. Code ch. 49 but no document gives a section number. The card's quote comes from D083, a Rent Board rates page in the supplied corpus, not the law's text. None of the documents contains ch. 49's own text, so the card could not be checked for a missing condition on who qualifies.
